reel_check.source: yes: Activision announcement on the Call of Duty Steam page 6 Nov 19:53Z, title 'The DMZ Free Trial begins Now! PLAY DMZ FOR FREE UNTIL NOV 11 AT 10AM PT' (read through the server digest seq 157; WebFetch of the page was refused as unapproved, so the body was not read); Insider Gaming reported the same evening; Call of Duty blog read for Season 1 (6 Nov, Hajin Exclusion Zone, X01); ledger find clean, Publer scheduled list empty
reel_check.angle: yes: hook: DMZ, normally part of the paid game, is free to play; why now: trial started tonight with Season 1; players here: ends Wed 11 Nov 22:00 Dubai (10:00 PST); payoff: Season 1 and the new Hajin zone are live to try
reel_check.type: yes: FREE / EVENT: the window (until 11 Nov 22:00 Dubai, from Activision's 10AM PT), what is free (DMZ mode), the source Activision
reel_check.footage: yes: MW4 Steam 'Multiplayer' trailer, the 110 to 145 s stretch pinned at live/2026-10-26/uk-mw4-mp.mp4 for the UK chart Reel (decode clean then); shots 2.0 to 12.0 s (frames looked at: masked operator, tablet, squad under the skyline, supply drop, map; v1 run failed on the source smear at the 12.07 s cut, and 12 to 14 s carries the burnt-in KILL BLOCK title, so the stretch ends at 12.0), clear of the blood frame at file 21 s (trailer 131 s) noted in that story; no DMZ-specific trailer reachable from the container (Steam store page age-gated in WebFetch, Steam API blocked by the proxy)
